title: Gyuvetch (Balkan Vegetable Stew)
subtitle: baked to thicken
description: A rich Balkan ratatouille of eggplant, zucchini and tomato, simmered and then finished in the oven to thicken. Serve with bread for mopping up.

steps.text: Cut the eggplants into cubes. Heat olive oil in a deep pan and fry the eggplant until golden. Remove to a plate and set aside.

Meanwhile cut all the other vegetables into cubes. Fry the onion in the same pan until golden. Add the capsicum, keep cooking, then add the zucchini, tomatoes and sliced garlic. Cook for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Return the eggplant to the pan, then add the tomato paste, boiling water and thyme. Stir, bring to the boil, season, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove the lid and put in the oven for 20 minutes, until browned and golden.
